proposed_rules.trigger: A multi-column feature-by-feature comparison table ([6x1] header row followed by [6x1] data rows) comparing Knack against competitors.
proposed_rules.decision: Model as ONE 'comparison-table' block with the header as the first row and each feature as a subsequent row (12 rows x 6 cols).
proposed_rules.rationale: Rejected alternatives: separate block per competitor column (breaks row-per-item authoring); default-content markdown table instead of a block (loses reusable component styling for repeated comparison tables across pages).
